origin.description: Formats a numeric vector and writes a tagged missing value as NA(letter).

arguments.name: digits
arguments.text: Significant digits used for the finite numbers.

origin.details: The strings are right-justified to a common width.
origin.example:
x <- c(1:5, tagged_na("a"), tagged_na("z"), NA)
print(format_tagged_na(x))

translation.description: Formats a numeric vector and writes a tagged missing value as NA(letter).

arguments.name: digits
arguments.text: Significant digits used for the finite numbers.

translation.details: The strings are right-justified to a common width.
translation.example:
from haven import format_tagged_na, tagged_na
x = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] + tagged_na("a", "z") + [float("nan")]
print(format_tagged_na(x))
